title: iPod Touch - Wikipedia
snippet:
The iPod Touch was the last product in Apple's iPod product line after the discontinuation of the iPod Nano and iPod Shuffle on July 27, 2017, after which Apple revised the storage and pricing for the iPod Touch with 32 and 128 GB of storage. On May 10, 2022, Apple discontinued the iPod Touch, effectively ending the iPod product line. The last iOS version to support the seventh-generation iPod Touch is iOS 15.

title: Apple's iPod Touch Is Discontinued, Ending the Music Player's Legacy - CNET
snippet:
34-ipod-touch-7th-gen-recovered-ipod-anniversary-history-evolution-cnet-2021-retrospective

Apple’s iPod Touch lineup was always in the shadow of the iPhone.

Apple said it will continue selling remaining iPod Touch devices through its website starting at $199 apiece until supplies are gone. The company offers the device in 32GB, 128GB and 256GB models, and in six colors including silver, pink, blue and gold. [...] Just as Apple’s preparing to enter the iPhone’s 15th year since release, the iPod Touch, its less popular cousin, is taking its final bow. Apple announced Tuesday that the iPhone-iPod hybrid device released in 2007 will no longer be available after all its supplies run out. The move marks an end not just for the handheld device but also an end to the iPod product line, which helped reshape the entertainment industry two decades ago. [...] The lineup expanded over the years to include the iPod Mini, iPod Nano and iPod Shuffle, in addition to the classic iPod. Apple stopped selling those iPods between 2014 and 2017.
